newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil closes up on thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil closes up on thin volume.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,170 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,170 *
Open/hi/low 1,156/1,172/1,154 Prev close 1,170
Prev settlement 1,162 * sellers prices
PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended higher on short covering.
Volume was thin with some players on extended holiday. Market focusing on PORLA crop report due on Friday. January contract seen trading between 1,140 and 1,180 this week.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Very quiet with prices locked in tight ranges. Trades were confined to Nov crude palm oil and selected refined products.
Prices started on a weaker note following overnight losses in Chicago soyoil futures due to fears that the U.S.-China trade dispute could escalate.

China said on Sunday it would suspend temporarily its imports of some U.S. textiles, farm goods, animal husbandry products, fruits and alcoholic drinks in retaliation for Washington's imposition of punitive charges on U.S. purchases of Chinese textiles.
Third position January crude palm oil futures closed at 1,170 ringgit ($464.29) a tonne after hitting a low of 1,154 in early trade.
Traders said they expect the contract to trade between 1,140 and 1,180 ringgit this week.
Volume on the futures market was 1,031 lots against 685 lots on Friday.
Physicals prices ended little changed after being locked in tight ranges throughout the session.

Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,170 ringgit ($464.29) a tonne with bids at 1,165, after trading at 1,167.50 and 1,170. Nov (central) was offered at 1,160 with bids at 1,150, and traded from 1,145 to 1,150.
Nov (north) saw offers at 1,150 and bids at 1,140.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,185 ringgit with bids at 1,175. It was traded from 1,170 to 1,180.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,175 and bids at 1,165.
Among refined products, Nov RBD palm olein was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $537.50. Dec was traded at $534 and $536.
Nov RBD palm oil was offered at $505, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $502.50. Nov was done at $497.50 and Dec at $495.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $370 and Dec at $375.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $307.50.
